fusions.name: Pinch and Pocket
fusions.desc: Consumes one of your afflictions on the target to pinch it for 8 damage, adding 1.2 times the affliction's remaining damage. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Finger-Quick Flurry
fusions.desc: A flurry of 4 strikes that deals 27 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nimble Knuckles
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 15 seconds and gives you 6% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Light Touch

riders.text: and nothing closes on you in time

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1.
